comparison.objective: PR-1805 secures a bicycle wheel to a stand with a two-part U-lock; the candidate calibrates and locks a robot-gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1805 tests threading a rigid shackle through spokes and angled bent-foot crossbar engagement, not concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1805 requires correct wheel/stand enclosure and latched crossbar after release; the candidate requires a retained 90° setting, locked nuts, three repeatable cycles, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Linking two fixed objects with an angled lock is meaningfully different from preserving an adjustable screw setting while tightening its jam nut and function-cycling it.
